result.rationale: The diff shows `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` in poll_feed.rb with no rescue and `sidekiq_options retry: false`. RSS 2.0 feeds commonly omit content:encoded, in which case simple-rss would yield nil for i.content, raising NoMethodError and aborting the loop so later items are never imported. The mechanism (no error handling, no retry) is verifiable in the diff; whether nil occurs depends on external feed behavior, but the code has no fallback to i.description.

judged_text: The item loop has no error handling and i.content is nil for feed items without a content element (RSS 2.0 feeds that only provide description), so CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) raises NoMethodError. With sidekiq_options retry: false the run aborts at the first bad item and every subsequent hourly run crashes at the same item, so items after it are never imported — the feed is permanently stuck with no recovery path.
